meta.title: Baila Bien Mainz — Salsa & Latin Dance
meta.description: Salsa On1 in Mainz. No experience, no partner needed. Every Tuesday.

about.heading: About us
about.text: At Baila Bien we share our love of Latin dance. Learn salsa from scratch in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere – no experience and no dance partner required. Come by, dance with us and become part of our community.

classes.heading: Classes
classes.intro: One evening, three levels, social dance in between — one continuous flow.
classes.drinkNote: Feel free to grab a drink at the bar anytime 🍹
classes.locationNote: Address of the venue, not of the provider.

items.title: Level 1 — Beginner
items.intro: Perfect for students with little or no salsa experience.
items.note: No partner or previous experience is required. Students rotate partners during the class.

items.title: Level 2 — Foundation
items.intro: For students who already know the basic steps, basic turns, and Cross Body Lead.
items.focus: This level focuses on building a strong foundation and connecting moves into smooth combinations.

items.title: Level 3 — Improver
items.intro: For dancers who are comfortable with the fundamentals and want to improve their social dancing.
items.focus: The focus is on technique, partner connection, and more advanced combinations.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.footnote: *Student price for under-28 with valid ID.
notes: Missed classes do not affect pricing.

sections.heading: 2. Hosting
sections.body:
This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., USA. When the site is accessed, technically necessary data (including IP address, date and time, requested resource) is processed in server logs. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in secure, stable operation (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).

Please note: data may be transferred to the USA in the process; this is based on the EU standard contractual clauses or on a certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: 3. Contact and sign-up form
sections.body: When you sign up for a trial class through the form, we process the data you provide (name, email, phone if given, level, preferred date, message) in order to handle your request. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR) as well as steps taken prior to entering into a contract and the performance of that contract (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). For delivery we use [[MAIL PROCESSOR – TODO: fill in once the form is connected]] as a processor on the basis of a data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR). We store the data only for as long as is necessary to handle your request and delete it afterwards, unless statutory retention obligations apply. You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.

sections.heading: 4. Fonts
sections.body: Fonts are served locally from our own server (no Google Fonts CDN). No data is transmitted to third parties in the process.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies / tracking
sections.body:
This website sets no non-essential cookies and uses no analytics or tracking services. Your language and colour scheme preferences are stored solely in your browser (localStorage) and are not transmitted to us.

We do not embed any Instagram content. The preview images and videos in the Instagram section are served from our own server; the cards merely link to Instagram. Opening this page therefore transfers no data to Meta. Only once you follow one of those links and open Instagram do the privacy terms of Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. apply.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21 GDPR). To exercise them, contact bailabien.mz.de@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 7. Right to lodge a complaint
sections.body: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The competent authority is: Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Rheinland-Pfalz.

sections.heading: 8. SSL/TLS encryption
